notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
[h3][b]Some Basic Issues Have Been Fixed.[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that allowed the same weapon to be sold repeatedly.
[*]Fixed a crash that occurred when the time hit 10:00.
[*]Resolved an issue where weapons could be dropped behind walls and similar obstacles.
[*]Adjusted the pivots of some shelves and furniture.
[*][b]You can now buy plants and posters for your shop.[/b]
[*]Fixed the issue where players could stand on top of dirt spots in the shop.
[*]Fixed a flickering issue when opening the map using the "M" key.
[*]Resolved the issue of selling items to customers without speaking to them.
[*]Fixed a bug where some empty boxes would disappear unexpectedly.
[/list]
